title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Yash Chaurasia and Chandan Shivaraj in the M25 Bhubaneswar, Qualifying, originally scheduled for November 15, 2026 at 12:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Yash Chaurasia' if Yash Chaurasia advances against Chandan Shivaraj.

This market will resolve to 'Chandan Shivaraj' if Chandan Shivaraj advances against Yash Chaurasia.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 29, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
